remote_vm: Google Cloud Remote Sandbox — Close Your Laptop, Agents Keep Shipping

plan.architecture_summary: Delhi checkouts stalled from retry storms; we will expand queue capacity, add smart retry limits, and enable fast local backup reads.
key_risks: Clock drift between regions could temporarily halt checkouts if safety limits are exceeded.
Serving brief local backup reads during outages may show slightly outdated inventory.
plan.risk_assessment: Low operational risk when deployed with automated latency monitoring and instant regional rollback.

workers.plain_goal: Increase server queue size to handle flash sale traffic.
workers.task: Update the production checkout pool policy to raise max_envoy_pending_requests from 64 to 512 for Delhi flash sale bursts.

workers.plain_goal: Stop endless retries and pause traffic when servers struggle.
workers.task: Replace synchronous unbounded retries with a jittered exponential circuit breaker capped at 2 retries and a 5-failure threshold.

workers.plain_goal: Serve fast local backup reads when primary servers slow down.
workers.task: Configure Spanner Omni bounded stale-read fallback under 15ms during OPEN circuit states and validate p99 latency under 20ms via benchmark_policy.
